At 18 h, three 1:10 dilutions read 0.1215, 0.1174, and 0.1221, corresponding to 1.174–1.221 (mean 1.203), versus the undiluted reading of 1.1612. If the undiluted readings were proportional to biomass, dilution-corrected values should agree with them. Instead, both late-time diluted measurements are consistently about 0.042 OD (3.6%) higher, indicating mild compression/saturation of the undiluted readings.
